data.name: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast
data.detailed_description:
Return to the world of Nocturnals, where civilisation struggles to recover decades after creatures from outer-space laid it to ruin.

Play as Ted, a hopeful survivor chasing rumours of a forgotten community deep within the foggy state of Cacti Coast.

Along the way, you'll make friends and foes, all with differing views on what Cacti Coast has become - and what it should be. Your choices will shape not only Ted’s beliefs, but also the companions who join him and the places he dares to go.

Gameplay Features:

  • Your story continues: If you played Nocturnals, your ending carries over. Does Ted start his journey resentful and alone, or is he accompanied by a close companion, Diego?

  • Non-linear exploration: Choose where to travel next. Each location across Cacti Coast offers a unique narrative, with characters, dilemmas, and philosophies that can influence your path.

  • Companions and consequences: Characters you meet may choose to join your journey - or walk away, depending on your actions.

Continue your story or carve out a new one in Nocturnals: Cacti Coast, coming 2027.

data.short_description: A narrative-driven, choose-your-own-adventure game where a young survivor must make difficult decisions in order to survive the foggy wasteland of Cacti Coast and find a community to call home.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with at least 1gb of VRAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These are the minimum requirements to play on Low graphics settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with at least 8gb of VRAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These are the reccommended requirements to play on High settings.
